The '''anti-launch cylinder''' was a component used in [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms']] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]]. When homing rockets were loaded into the MM9, the projectiles were locked into place by the anti-launch cylinder, allowing the launcher's integrated [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] to interface with the rocket's onboard systems. Pressing the launcher's anti-launch release stud enabled the [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] and activated the [[Targeting laser/Legends|targeting laser]], allowing the rocket to track a target once launched.<ref name="EGWT" />
